posts.story: Hotel restaurant GST: a room sold above Rs 7,500 last year makes the hotel's restaurant bills 18% with input credit instead of 5% without; Rizstay stay code and live orders
lines: Hotel owners, your restaurant might be charging the wrong GST.
Rule 1. Sold any room above ₹7,500 a night last financial year?
Then your restaurant bills this year carry 18% GST. Not 5.
A ₹2,000 dinner? That's ₹360 of GST, not ₹100. Send this to whoever does your billing.
Rule 2. Every room at ₹7,500 or less? Food stays at 5%, but you can't claim input credit.
Rule 3. On the 18% side, you claim back the GST you paid on supplies.
In Rizstay, new, preparing and ready orders update live on every screen.
Room guests type a private stay code. They see their stay, amenities and running bill.
Comment RATE. I'll send you the 1 page check. Follow so my DM reaches you.

posts.story: Bablu ka Hotel (English): the hotel across the street is full because it posts every day; Priya says they posted once in March; Kaka says let someone write, make and post it for you while you just approve on your phone (Velocity); replies and guest messages come to the phone; Bablu fully booked
posts.hook: Our food is better. So why are we *empty*?
lines: Our food is better. So why is that hotel full... and we are empty?
Sir, they post on Instagram every single day. We posted once... in March.
Then let someone do it for you, beta. They write your posts,
make the videos, and post on time. You just say yes, on your phone.
And it replies to comments, and every guest message comes straight to our phone. Nothing goes out without your okay, sir.
Fully booked this weekend... and I did not write a single post!
